description: Coded democratic-participation TARGET registry entry — one record per organ × channel-kind, holding the organ (議会 / 行政機関 / 選管 / parliament / agency / electoral body) / channel / 根拠法令 (legal basis) / 提出様式 (form) / 期限 (deadline) / 紹介議員-required flag so a moushibumi cell can route + (eventually) file procedurally (ADR-2605312400 §2). WORLDWIDE coverage (multi-jurisdiction: JP/US/EU/UK-CW/INTL). OPEN DATA (derived from the organ's published guidance; provenance mandatory). CONSTITUTIONAL: moushibumi is a citizen-voice CONCIERGE — INFORMATIONAL + drafting-assist + member self-submission ONLY; it is NEVER an official channel and renders NO legal advice (UPL boundary — characterization/appeals → licensed counsel). `verificationStatus` gates live submission (G14). `channelKind=election-info` entries are INFO-ONLY (G3 — politically NEUTRAL reference to official sources only; NO campaigning/endorsement/candidate-ranking/GOTV; no submission channel). `channelKind=citizen-initiative` entries are member-initiated own-voice routing/wayfinding to the OFFICIAL initiative channel; moushibumi never drafts initiative text, advocates for/against measures, coordinates signature campaigns, lobbies, or takes any fee/consideration (zero-compensation, non-partisan, non-commercial — G9). Never fabricate (G8): `legalBasis` + `provenance` mandatory.

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3166 alpha-3 or bloc/supranational tag, e.g. jpn / usa / deu / fra / gbr / can / aus / ind / sgp / bra / mex / kor / eu-wide / intl-un

channelKind.description: election-info is INFO-ONLY (G3 — neutral reference to official sources, no submission); citizen-initiative is member-initiated own-voice wayfinding to the OFFICIAL initiative channel (no drafting/advocacy/signature-coordination/fee — G9)

organ.description: The responsible 議会 / 行政機関 / 選管 / parliament / agency / electoral body / committee

channelType.description: HOW the voice is filed (or info-only). via-introducing-member / web-portal-via-mp note a required sponsoring legislator — moushibumi states the requirement, never arranges/lobbies one (G9)

introducingMemberRequired.description: 請願 to the Diet requires a 紹介議員 (国会法 §79); moushibumi notes the requirement, never arranges/lobbies one (G9)

submissionForm.description: 提出様式 description (or info-only note)

deadline.description: Comment window / 会期 / 締切 description

legalBasis.description: 根拠法令 / legal basis — MANDATORY (G8), e.g. '請願法; 国会法 §79' / '行政手続法 §39' / 'Administrative Procedure Act, 5 U.S.C. § 553' / 'Regulation (EU) 2019/788'

provenance.description: Source URL (the organ's published guidance) — MANDATORY (G8)

verificationStatus.description: G14 submission gate. unverified-seed => routing/info-design only, NO live submission.
